baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَدُ اللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ / غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ / يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ repeats hand and reverses its condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A doctrinal utterance assigns restraint to divine agency; the same restraint is returned to the speakers' plural hands, while the answer unfolds hand as benefaction, capacity, and active giving. The causal phrase بِمَا قَالُوا makes the return depend on what they committed themselves to saying.

activation_trace.role: Treats the quoted saying as a held doctrine, making it the commitment that rebounds on its speakers.
Supplies hand as bestowed favor, carrying benefaction through the accusation, its reversal, and the answer.
Supplies a restraint fastened to the limb and makes the repeated passive forms a concrete reversal of agency.
Supplies an extended, released hand and functions as the direct contrary of imposed restraint.
Supplies wealth going outward and turns open capacity into an enacted rather than merely pictured generosity.

changed_reading.before: A charge of stinginess is followed by a curse and a correction.
changed_reading.after: The charge is a reflexive attribution: speech that imagines divine agency bound returns as the speakers' own incapacity, while divine agency is shown by continuing outward action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open hands and يُنفِقُ stand in the same ayah as concealed grace, war, acquisitive striving, and فساد.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah opposes two economies. One releases what is held and sends benefit outward; the other treats power as possession, covers received favor, strips through war, and works until the surrounding order loses soundness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hand as possession and disposal, making the dispute concern what power does with what it holds.
Supplies expenditure as value leaving one's holdings and defines the outward-moving economy.
Supplies concealment of a favor and makes disbelief a refusal to register what has arrived.
Supplies stripping and seizure of wealth, giving the war-fire an extractive material function.
Supplies sustained work and earning, here functioning as organized labor directed toward damage.
Supplies departure from sound order and names the systemic result of the extractive circulation.

changed_reading.before: The generosity statement and the later charges of war and corruption are separate topics.
changed_reading.after: They form rival circulation systems: open power releases provision, while possessive power conceals, strips, and converts collective work into structural loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: غ ل ل, العداوة, البغضاء, ignition, war-fire, and extinguishing form an affective-to-material sequence inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Restraint can contain unresolved heat and rancor. That inward pressure is socially distributed as enmity and hatred, takes material form as repeatedly kindled conflict, and is repeatedly cooled rather than allowed to complete its destructive course.

activation_trace.role: Supplies heat penetrating the interior and makes restraint a container for intensifying affect.
Supplies concealed rancor in the chest and identifies the social fuel hidden within the restraint image.
Supplies active enmity and externalizes the inward rancor as a durable relation.
Supplies affective aversion and joins the relational conflict to a repelling inner disposition.
Supplies rapidly flaring intensity and converts accumulated affect into recurrent mobilization.
Supplies a feud occurring among people and lets the fire lexeme carry the social relation it materializes.
Supplies cooling and stilling of flame and functions as repeated interruption of the escalation.

changed_reading.before: Enmity and repeated wars are adjacent punishments.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a conversion cycle in which contained rancor becomes social polarization, flares into war, and is repeatedly cooled before it can stabilize as victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence of entering with disbelief, leaving with it, and hiding the interior activates the nonfinancial passage branches of ن ف ق. In the focus, يُنفِقُ can retain ordinary spending while also imaging an unobstructed outlet, opposed to circulation whose entrance is displayed and whose exit is concealed.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a passage with an outlet and makes divine expenditure spatially open rather than blocked.
Supplies a displayed entrance paired with a hidden exit and furnishes the negative counterpart to transparent outflow.
Supplies movement into an interior and starts the context's transit pattern.
Supplies movement out of an interior and completes the visible path through the group.
Supplies concealment and marks the context passage as morally hidden rather than merely spatial.

structural_cues: 5:61 orders declaration, entry with disbelief, exit with it, and divine knowledge of concealment; 5:64 places يُنفِقُ immediately after released hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry, exit, concealment, and the passage/display branches of ن ف ق; I infer a contrast between honest outflow and duplicitous transit. Ordinary financial spending remains the primary live alternative.

changed_reading.before: يُنفِقُ only specifies generous financial spending.
changed_reading.after: It also carries an exploratory spatial answer to the accusation of blockage: divine giving has a real outlet, unlike a social passage organized around hidden interiors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rapid movement into wrongdoing and consuming illicit gain is followed by the failure of learned authorities to restrain sinful speech and consumption. Against that context, the focus's bound plural hands become a reversal of unused regulatory capacity: restraint absent where appetite should have been checked returns as collective incapacity, while divine action remains outward-giving.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hands as accountable action and lets the plural hands stand for what the collective actually does or fails to do.
Supplies imposed restraint on the acting limb and functions as returned institutional incapacity.
Supplies value moving outward and opposes the context's acquisitive intake.
Supplies acceleration and makes appetite a practiced rush rather than a single lapse.
Supplies consumption as taking and exhausting wealth, forming the inward-moving rival to expenditure.
Supplies stripping something away to exhaustion and gives illicit consumption a depleting social effect.
Supplies active checking of conduct and identifies the restraint the authorities fail to exercise.

structural_cues: 5:62 pairs haste with consuming illicit gain; 5:63 asks why learned authorities do not stop both sinful speech and consumption; 5:64 then reverses hand-restraint onto the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accelerated intake, depletion, failed prohibition, and accountable hands; I infer that unused ethical restraint returns as incapacity. A live alternative is that the bound hands denote punishment without an institutional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their bound hands are a generic retaliatory curse.
changed_reading.after: The curse exposes a failed economy of restraint: hands that did not check predatory intake become unable to act, opposite the hand that continually releases provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root family can mark human covering of grace in the focus and divine covering of bad deeds in 5:65. The next ayah connects upholding revelation to provision from above and below and to a measured community. The open hands therefore govern an ordered economy in which covering can either refuse a gift or protect a person from a wrong.

activation_trace.role: Supplies concealment of received favor and gives the focus occurrence a wrong-way direction.
Supplies protective covering of an offense and reverses the same root family's moral direction.
Supplies upright maintenance and makes received revelation something enacted and kept in working order.
Supplies an apportioned livelihood and renders eating here as received provision rather than predatory intake.
Supplies the upper direction and opens one side of the promised field of provision.
Supplies the lower direction and completes the spatial enclosure of provision.
Supplies measured balance between extremes and shows that abundance need not become overflow.

structural_cues: 5:65-66 move from faith and guarding, through covered wrongs, to upholding revelation, provision from both vertical directions, and a measured subgroup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite covering branches, upright maintenance, encompassing provision, and moderation; I infer a directional economy of covering. The alternative is to treat the two ك ف ر forms as unrelated conventional senses.

changed_reading.before: كفر in the focus is a generic label added to transgression.
changed_reading.after: It is one direction of covering within a reversible system: recipients can cover the gift, while God can cover their wrongs and restore ordered access to provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to deliver what was sent, the promise of protection, and the demand that scriptural communities uphold what was sent make revelation itself part of open-handed expenditure. The near-verbatim recurrence of the focus's increase clause in 5:68 locates the harmful increase in reception rather than in divine withholding or failed transmission.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hand as conferred benefit and lets the open hands include communicative gift.
Supplies delivery downward to a recipient and joins revelation to the ayah's movement of giving.
Supplies messenger and message as a linked transmission office.
Supplies delivery all the way to the recipient and rules out voluntary withholding.
Supplies the delivered object and identifies the same descending input as in the focus.
Supplies protective holding and removes hostile pressure as a reason for constricting transmission.
Supplies upright establishment and makes the recipients' task implementation rather than passive possession.
Supplies repeated delivery and confirms that the focus's same input continues to arrive without constriction.

structural_cues: 5:67 commands complete conveyance and promises protection; 5:68 repeats the focus's revelation-increases-many clause after requiring recipients to uphold what was sent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full delivery, protection, implementation, and exact verbal recurrence; I infer that open-handedness includes unwithheld disclosure. Material generosity remains a concurrent, not displaced, reading.

changed_reading.before: Open hands concern provision, while revelation later happens to provoke disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The open hands also refuse communicative scarcity: revelation is fully delivered, and its negative increase is a recipient-side transformation rather than a defect in the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:70-71 gives a recurrent reception cycle: a messenger arrives with what desire rejects, one faction denies and another kills, blindness and deafness follow, a return occurs, and closure recurs. This sharpens the focus's repeated ignition as the material conflict phase of a longer loop of resisted reception.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberate ignition and marks the point where the reception loop becomes organized combustion.
Supplies open hostilities and identifies the social form taken by the loop.
Supplies quenching and makes divine action a recurrent interruption rather than a claim that ignition never occurs.
Supplies repeated messengers and messages as the arriving input that begins the loop.
Supplies inward inclination and makes frustrated desire the selective gate on reception.
Supplies contradiction of truth and forms the verbal response branch of rejection.
Supplies lethal removal and forms the violent response branch of rejection.
Supplies loss of inward sight and marks repeated closure after the hostile response.
Supplies refusal or inability to hear and closes the input channel that could alter the cycle.

structural_cues: Both 5:70 and 5:64 use كُلَّمَا; 5:71 repeats blindness and deafness on both sides of a divine turning-back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching recurrence markers and a message-to-violence-to-closure sequence; I infer that the focus's war-fire is a downstream phase of that loop. The live alternative is a formal parallel without direct causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: Whenever they kindle war, God simply cancels an isolated military initiative.
changed_reading.after: Each war-fire is one recurrence of a deeper reception loop; quenching interrupts its violent output without erasing the disposition that restarts it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts embodied messengers who eat food with an object of worship that owns neither harm nor benefit. Read backward, the focus's hands describe effective capacity, possession, and disposal: unlike dependent bodies or powerless objects, divine agency can release benefit as it wills.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hand as power and makes the dual image an assertion of effective capacity.
Supplies possession and disposal and connects capacity to governance of benefit.
Supplies released reach and shows capacity in operation rather than as a static attribute.
Supplies bodily intake and marks the messengers' creaturely dependence.
Supplies sustenance and livelihood and identifies what the embodied pair must receive.
Supplies possession with power of disposal and provides the context's explicit agency test.
Supplies loss as one outcome that powerless objects cannot govern.
Supplies benefit as the contrary outcome and links the focus's giving to real efficacy.

structural_cues: 5:75 emphasizes that the messenger and his mother ate food; 5:76 immediately tests worship by ownership of harm and benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily dependence and an explicit possession/effect test; I infer backward disambiguation of the hand image toward capacity. Benefaction, sovereignty, and bodily imagery can still coexist at the rhetorical level.

changed_reading.before: The dual hands primarily intensify a bodily picture of generosity.
changed_reading.after: They map the reach of effective agency: possession, power, and disposal are unrestricted, and spending is the observable exercise of that capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descending message that increases many in transgressive overflow is heard by others, recognized, and followed by eyes filling until tears flow, then by enduring garden flow. Revelation functions as an amplifier whose output depends on reception: destructive excess and concealed truth on one route, recognition and life-giving flow on another.

activation_trace.role: Supplies increase and growth and defines revelation's amplifying effect without fixing its moral direction.
Supplies the delivered input whose reception branches into different outcomes.
Supplies water-like overflow beyond its limit and materializes the destructive output route.
Supplies the same kind of delivered input and holds the comparison constant across recipients.
Supplies easy abundant flow and forms the receptive counterpart to transgressive overflow.
Supplies a vessel filling until it spills and makes recognition an interior fullness that crosses its boundary.
Supplies recognition by a discernible mark and identifies the routing condition for the receptive flow.
Supplies continuing provision and extends momentary tears into durable beneficent circulation.
Supplies an opened, widened course through which flow can continue, completing the life-giving route.

structural_cues: 5:64 names descent followed by increase into طغيان; 5:83 repeats descent followed by recognition and overflowing tears; 5:85 resolves that response into enduring rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a constant descending input and contrasting overflow sequences; I infer that reception routes amplification. A live alternative is that the two flow fields are rhetorically parallel but not a causal model.

changed_reading.before: Revelation paradoxically causes greater rebellion in many recipients.
changed_reading.after: Revelation amplifies and exposes the receiving orientation: one vessel overflows its bounds, while another fills through recognition and joins a continuing economy of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's بِمَا قَالُوا leads to restrained hands and curse, while 5:85 uses the same causal wording for a saying followed by gardens. The return/recompense branch of ث و ب and explicit جزاء frame speech as a manifested commitment whose consequence comes back to its speaker.

activation_trace.role: Supplies speech as professed belief and makes the quoted claim an orientation rather than incidental wording.
Supplies consequence returning to the doer and establishes recompense as a return structure before the focus.
Supplies an answering profession that manifests recognition rather than concealment.
Supplies reward returning to its source and makes the later outcome the positive mirror of the focus.
Supplies the professed commitment named as the basis of the positive return.
Supplies matched consequence and confirms that the return is responsive rather than arbitrary.

structural_cues: 5:64 and 5:85 both use بِمَا قَالُوا but terminate in opposite outcomes; 5:60 introduces recompense before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored causal wording and return/recompense branches; I infer that speech indexes and externalizes a settled orientation. The live alternative is that the words are evidence of the orientation, not themselves causally efficient.

changed_reading.before: The opening claim is quoted mainly so that it can be refuted.
changed_reading.after: Speech is a return-bearing act in the pericope: constrictive attribution returns as constriction, while receptive confession returns as capacious provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a zoological branch under the focus's earth lexeme and a material-consumption branch from 5:62. It remains anchored in أَرْض and both focus occurrences of فساد, with context supplying eating as corrosion; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for slow internal decay, not as the lexical meaning of الأرض.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places striving in الأرض directly beside فساد and repeats the فساد root in the agent label.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a wood-eating inhabitant of earth and offers a concrete image of damage advancing inside supports.
Supplies loss of sound condition and names the structural result of the hidden consumption.
Supplies eating as corrosion and lets illicit intake activate the slow-decay analogy.

changed_reading.before: Striving in the earth for corruption denotes overt harmful activity in general.
changed_reading.after: Alongside overt war, corruption can be pictured as concealed consumption that hollows shared supports from within until their sound order fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a distant fire branch under the focus's final يُحِبُّ and links it to the preceding war-fire and the context's benefit test. It remains packet-anchored by the immediate fire sequence and the supplied branch, but downstream prose should mark it as a lexical echo or wordplay, never a replacement for the ordinary meaning 'love'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ follows immediately after ignition, extinguishing, and corruptive striving.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberately kindled flame and establishes the literal fire field near the closing verb.
Supplies active fire and keeps the material image live through the conflict clause.
Supplies weak sparks that yield no usable benefit and gives the nonlove closure an exploratory anti-productivity echo.
Supplies benefit as the comparison standard and sharpens the image of conflict heat that produces nothing useful.

changed_reading.before: God's nonlove is an evaluative sentence appended to the war and corruption sequence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, the ending also makes corruptive war resemble a shower of unusable sparks: intense activity with no life-serving yield.

strongest_changes: The mirrored outcomes of بِمَا قَالُوا turn speech into a return-bearing commitment rather than incidental quotation.
The same descending revelation routes into transgressive overflow or recognizing, life-giving overflow, making reception the branching mechanism.
Unchecked acquisitive intake and failed prohibition make the bound hands a reversal of unused ethical capacity.
Complete transmission and the repeated clause in 5:68 extend open-handedness from material provision to unwithheld disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly reverses direction: giving versus consuming, beneficial covering versus concealment, open transmission versus hidden transit, destructive overflow versus tears and rivers, and speech returning to its speaker.
remaining_uncertainties: The passage reading of ن ف ق is branch-valid but may remain secondary wordplay beneath ordinary spending.
The reception loop and war-fire share recurrence structure, but the packet does not prove that every ignition is caused by the immediately preceding rejection cycle.
The termite and unusable-spark outliers are material analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
